title: Baths of Caracalla
visualBrief: The roofless Baths of Caracalla follow the mapped Roman bath block. The paired palaestrae surround a tall open frigidarium with deep brick arches and exposed piers. The dry natatio, curving rooms, detached caldarium fragments and surviving enclosure walls preserve the site’s uneven silhouette.
nativeAxes: Positive X follows the transverse bath axis southeast, from the western to the eastern palaestra. Positive Z follows the central axis southwest, from the natatio toward the surviving caldarium fragment.
